changes.S26: Deactivating a profile cancels absences where that profile is owner or replacement; only that actor's open coverage clock is stopped, notifications are sent, and frozen units are preserved.
changes.S35: Bulk-close confirmation is fingerprinted to actor, month, exact scope, candidate units, group membership and readiness; result is scoped to the same preview context.
changes.S61: Candidate close groups are discarded atomically if monthly consolidation throws; independent successful groups remain retryable.
